leads.summary: The cache version collides with current quattro's existing v14 records
leads.location: bin/omarchy-menu-keybindings:548-551,575-581 (and current quattro tip version at merged-base/base-current.sh:536)
leads.consequence: An upgraded installation whose Super+K menu has already cached current quattro's v14 records continues reading those records after this PR is merged. Reset zoom, Zoom in and the universal clipboard functions retain empty dispatch metadata, so selecting them still exits 1 until the keyboard layout/binds change or that cache is deleted. The same hyprctl binds and keymap hash deliberately does not notice a code change; the only version bump this PR supplies, v13 to v14, was already made on quattro by #13521. Bump to a fresh version relative to current base (and any other overlapping cache-format change).
leads.triage: already in Opus final (F1); corroboration noted

leads.summary: A backslash in a user function bind's description prevents the re-lookup
leads.consequence: Descriptions in user Lua binds are unrestricted strings. The menu saves the literal description in its identity, but awk -v decodes backslash escapes before comparing that identity against the literal fields from hyprctl binds. A description containing a backslash, such as a Windows path, shows a row but selecting it returns 1 without dispatching; another label without a backslash succeeds. Pass identity via an input stream or compare separately without awk's -v escape interpretation.
leads.triage: already in Opus final (Not flagged); dropped: pre-existing; the existing awk -v selection fails on the same row first, so no visible change

leads.summary: New tests can pass even if selecting a menu row never calls a function
leads.consequence: The test extracts the helper definitions with sed and calls dispatch_binding directly rather than invoking the real CLI's selection/record lookup path. Replacing the CLI's sole call of dispatch_binding on selection with `true` still passes all 22 assertions, so a regression in wiring selected records to function dispatch is undetected. The fixture also supplies a full 'SUPER CTRL ALT + Z' key for ordinary Z, though Hyprland 0.56.2 outputs just Z. Add a full CLI test with a stub selector and a realistic hyprctl record; assert that a selected Reset zoom row rereads binds and dispatches its current ref.
leads.triage: factual, verified: head test runs the script only with --print (intake/head-test.sh:51); Opus re-ran the selection-call mutant in its self-check (draft-check-work run 20260930T211614Z-916ceee5); published as Optional test improvement; fixture key shape not published (harmless, file style)

leads.summary: Other non-stacked keybinding PRs require an explicit merged implementation
leads.consequence: The current changes do not merge mechanically with #11733 (replaces the Lua source scan and dispatch route), #13888 and #12557 (introduce id-based cache keys and TSV layout), #13461 (also changes the seven-field hyprctl parser) or #10468 (owns the cache version for keymap changes). If any of these merges first, this PR cannot simply land unchanged: resolve the corresponding hunks and adapt its new helper and tests to the merged representation. This is a textual integration conflict, not a claim that an unresolved tree has user-visible behavior.
leads.triage: already in Opus final (N2), except #10468 (cache version v16, counted in v17 suggestion); corroboration

## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** Merged into current `quattro`, the PR's `v14` cache bump matches the version `quattro` already uses, so caches written by current `quattro` are reused and `Reset zoom` and other function binds can still do nothing.

### Cache version `v14` is already used on `quattro`

`quattro` moved `keybindings_cache_key` from `v13` to `v14` in #13521. This PR makes the same one-line change, so the merge is silent and the merged script computes the same cache file name as current `quattro`. **Impact:** an install that opened the menu on a post-#13521 build keeps cached rows with blank dispatcher fields, so selecting a function bind still exits 1 until the binds, keymap or cache change.

**Suggested change:** after rebasing, bump to a version no other open PR uses (`v15` and `v16` are taken by other open PRs), for example `v17`.

<details><summary>Reproducer</summary>

The PR's `v14` cache version is the same value quattro already has since #13521, so after merging, a cache written by current quattro is reused and `Reset zoom` still does nothing. This is a merge interaction: it does not show on the PR head alone (its own base is `v13`), so it is a standalone script rather than a test case.

Needs `bash`, `gawk`, `lua`, `xkbcli` and `jq` (the menu's own dependencies). No Hyprland session: `hyprctl` and the menu picker are stubbed and put first on `PATH`.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/omacom/omarchy.git && cd omarchy
git fetch origin pull/11851/head
git worktree add --detach ../quattro 8b4eae66da2938ba9559f103b18dbf85cdf28a70
git worktree add --detach ../merged 8b4eae66da2938ba9559f103b18dbf85cdf28a70
git -C ../merged -c user.name=r -c user.email=r@example.invalid merge --no-edit 677ba24a4b5f8394bd4f36160a015076a17b7f3d
bash cache-version-repro.sh ../quattro ../merged
```

`cache-version-repro.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: cache-version-repro.sh <quattro checkout> <quattro with #11851 merged>
# Stubs hyprctl (one Lua function bind, as Hyprland 0.56.2 reports it) and the
# menu picker, lets quattro write the keybindings cache, then opens the menu
# on the merged tree with the same cache directory and picks Reset zoom.
set -u
ulimit -c 0
old=$1 new=$2
work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$work/bin" "$work/home/.config"
cp -r "$new/config/hypr" "$work/home/.config/hypr"

cat >"$work/bin/hyprctl" <<'STUB'
#!/bin/bash
printf '%s\n' "$*" >>"$LOG"
case "$1" in
  binds) printf 'bindd\n\tmodmask: 76\n\tsubmap: \n\tkey: Z\n\tkeycode: 0\n\tcatchall: false\n\tdescription: Reset zoom\n\tdispatcher: __lua\n\targ: 264\n\n' ;;
  devices) echo "active keymap: English (US)" ;;
  dispatch) echo ok ;;
esac
STUB
cat >"$work/bin/omarchy-menu-select" <<'STUB'
#!/bin/bash
grep -m1 -- '→ Reset zoom$'
STUB
chmod +x "$work/bin/hyprctl" "$work/bin/omarchy-menu-select"

menu() {
  : >"$work/log"
  env -i PATH="$work/bin:$1/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" HOME="$work/home" \
    XDG_CACHE_HOME="$work/cache" OMARCHY_PATH="$1" LOG="$work/log" \
    bash "$1/bin/omarchy-menu-keybindings" >/dev/null
  echo "exit status: $?"
  grep '^dispatch' "$work/log" || echo "nothing dispatched"
}

echo "== quattro opens the menu and writes the cache"
menu "$old"
ls "$work/cache/omarchy"
echo "== quattro + #11851 opens the menu with that cache"
menu "$new"
ls "$work/cache/omarchy"
rm -rf "$work/cache"
echo "== quattro + #11851 with the cache cleared"
menu "$new"
```

<details><summary>Verified</summary>

- `debug.getregistry()[<ref>]` through `hyprctl dispatch` calls the same function, with the same zero arguments, that a key press calls on Hyprland 0.56.2 (source reading).
- The recorded identity survives scan, cache, menu selection and the reread for `code:`, `mouse:` and submap binds; a ref moved by a reload dispatches the new ref.
- Source-resolved rows such as `Close window` keep their expressions.
- The PR's tests pass on the head (22) and on the merged tree (23), and the first new assertion fails against the base and `quattro` scripts.

</details>

<details><summary>Optional notes</summary>

- **Optional test improvement:** the new tests call `dispatch_binding` directly. Replacing the script's only selection-path call with `true` still passes all 22 assertions. A test that runs the script with a stubbed `omarchy-menu-select` picking `Reset zoom` would cover that wiring.
- **Hyprland main:** hyprwm/Hyprland#15722 (merged after 0.56.2) reports Lua binds as `function: 0x…` or `HL.Dispatcher(<name>)` instead of `__lua`. From source, both the existing `__lua` lookup and this new path would stop matching once that ships (not run against Hyprland).
- **Related open PRs:** #12557 and #13888 conflict with this PR in `dynamic_bindings`; #13461 adds the same `submap` field and also conflicts; #11733 (the broader rewrite the PR description mentions) also conflicts.

</details>
